005package org.wpilib.telemetry;
006
007/**
008 * Interface for telemetry backends.
009 *
010 * <p>Implementations registered with {@link TelemetryRegistry} must be thread-safe. Backend and
011 * entry methods may be called concurrently, and entry removal or backend closure may overlap a call
012 * already in progress on a previously returned entry.
013 */
014public interface TelemetryBackend extends AutoCloseable {
015  /**
016   * Create an entry for the given path.
017   *
018   * <p>Backend implementations must not throw from this method. Recoverable failures should be
019   * reported through {@link TelemetryRegistry#reportWarning(String, String)} and represented with a
020   * discard entry.
021   *
022   * @param path full name
023   * @return telemetry entry
024   */
025  TelemetryEntry getEntry(String path);
026
027  /**
028   * Returns whether this backend is or owns the given backend instance for lifecycle purposes.
029   *
030   * <p>Composite backends should override this and recursively check child backends that are closed
031   * when this backend is closed. The registry uses this to avoid closing a displaced backend that
032   * is now retained by another registered backend.
033   *
034   * @param backend backend instance
035   * @return True if this backend is or owns the given backend
036   */
037  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
038  default boolean ownsBackend(TelemetryBackend backend) {
039    return this == backend;
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Returns whether this backend shares lifecycle ownership with another backend.
044   *
045   * <p>The registry uses this to avoid closing displaced backends whose close operation would close
046   * a backend that remains registered elsewhere.
047   *
048   * @param backend backend instance
049   * @return True if this backend owns, is owned by, or shares a child backend with the given
050   *     backend
051   */
052  default boolean sharesBackendWith(TelemetryBackend backend) {
053    return ownsBackend(backend) || backend.ownsBackend(this);
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Removes an entry for the given path.
058   *
059   * <p>Backend implementations must not throw from this method.
060   *
061   * @param path normalized full name
062   */
063  default void removeEntry(String path) {}
064}
